bestiary.jaymoskingdoms.kind.dead.0: Cold, and it doesn't breathe. It was someone once.
bestiary.jaymoskingdoms.kind.dead.1: It comes straight on and doesn't stop for a wound. Take the legs or take the head.
bestiary.jaymoskingdoms.kind.dead.2: Fire troubles it. Clean silver troubles it more.
bestiary.jaymoskingdoms.kind.corpse_eate: Where the dead are left, these come. They smell of old graves.
They hang back until you're hurt, then come in a rush.
They hate fire and silver, and a burned one stays burned.
bestiary.jaymoskingdoms.kind.brutes.0: Big, slow to start and hard to stop. The ground shakes first.
bestiary.jaymoskingdoms.kind.brutes.1: One heavy swing, then a long breath. Step aside and strike while it recovers.
bestiary.jaymoskingdoms.kind.brutes.2: It has a hide like bark and a head like a stone. Go for what's soft.
bestiary.jaymoskingdoms.kind.beasts.0: Hungry and not clever, but patient. It has done this before.
bestiary.jaymoskingdoms.kind.beasts.1: It circles, then goes for the leg. Keep your back to a wall.
bestiary.jaymoskingdoms.kind.beasts.2: A bright fire and a loud voice make it think twice.
bestiary.jaymoskingdoms.kind.spirits.0: More a chill than a body. You see it best from the corner of your eye.
bestiary.jaymoskingdoms.kind.spirits.1: It drifts in close and drains the warmth from you. Don't stand and trade.
bestiary.jaymoskingdoms.kind.spirits.2: Plain iron passes through it. Silver and bright light do not.
bestiary.jaymoskingdoms.kind.cursed.0: It looks like a person by day. Look at the eyes.
bestiary.jaymoskingdoms.kind.cursed.1: It is faster than it looks and heals what you do to it. Finish it quickly.
bestiary.jaymoskingdoms.kind.cursed.2: Silver burns it, and nothing else cuts as deep.
bestiary.jaymoskingdoms.kind.people.0: One of us, or was. It thinks, and it learns how you fight.
bestiary.jaymoskingdoms.kind.people.1: It feints, flanks and runs for help. Steel does its work well here.
bestiary.jaymoskingdoms.kind.people.2: It is afraid of what anyone is afraid of: being outnumbered, and being alone.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.herbalist.fears: Ask me what frightens the things out on the road.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.herbalist.fears.to: Mind what I tell you now. Write it down.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.herbalist.fears.no: I've told you all I know of those. Meet more of them, then ask.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.214: Your bestiary has a page for every kind of monster you meet. Fight one to fill its page in, and ask an herbalist or a sage what it fears. Silver hurts the dead, spirits and cursed, and steel a little more against people and beasts.
